OFFS.description: Beam End Offset (OFFS). Keyed by element number; ITEMS holds one or more offset definitions whose TYPE (GLOBAL or ELEMENT) selects which distance fields apply.

ITEMS.description: List of beam end offset definitions to assign to the keyed element.

items.description: A single beam end offset. TYPE selects the reference frame: GLOBAL uses RGDXi/RGDXj (GCS vector components); ELEMENT ignores RGDXi/RGDXj. RGDYi/RGDZi/RGDYj/RGDZj apply for both TYPEs.

ID.description: Serial number of the offset within the element key. 0 lets the program assign/derive it.

GROUP_NAME.description: Name of the boundary group this offset belongs to. Empty means no group; a non-empty name must already exist.

TYPE.description: Reference coordinate system of the offset (case-insensitive). GLOBAL = GCS (nOffsetType 1), ELEMENT = element local axes (nOffsetType 2).

RGDXi.description: [TYPE=GLOBAL] End offset distance at the i-end (N1) along GCS X. Not used for TYPE=ELEMENT.

RGDYi.description: End offset distance at the i-end (N1): GLOBAL -> GCS Y; ELEMENT -> local Y (Mzi). Applies for both TYPEs.

RGDZi.description: End offset distance at the i-end (N1): GLOBAL -> GCS Z; ELEMENT -> local Z (Myi). Applies for both TYPEs.

RGDXj.description: [TYPE=GLOBAL] End offset distance at the j-end (N2) along GCS X. Not used for TYPE=ELEMENT.

RGDYj.description: End offset distance at the j-end (N2): GLOBAL -> GCS Y; ELEMENT -> local Y (Mzj). Applies for both TYPEs.

RGDZj.description: End offset distance at the j-end (N2): GLOBAL -> GCS Z; ELEMENT -> local Z (Myj). Applies for both TYPEs.
